manifesto: Observed problem | Evidence | Affected files | Root cause | Why this is root cause | Correct fix | Files changed | Tests | Command | Result | Proof | Remaining risk

defects.observed_problem: Every Magic Link click and every context handoff wrote its raw one-time token into the edge access log.
defects.evidence: N-1 image pair (1e8bd5f): GET /auth/verify and /auth/switch, each with a synthetic canary value in ?token=, → `docker logs` showed both full request lines including the canary.
defects.root_cause: No access_log/log_format was defined, so the base image's `main` format applied; it logs "$request" (path + query string) and "$http_referer".
defects.why_root_cause: Tokens travel only in the query string (MagicLoginLinkNotification: /auth/verify?token=<raw>; ContextSwitchController reads ?token). The app never logs them; only the edge's request-line logging captured them.
defects.correct_fix: An http-level `servana_edge` JSON log format that records the path captured from $request_uri WITHOUT its query string, no referer, plus host/status/timings/request_id; every server block uses it.
tests: scripts/ui17-edge-security-contract.mjs (format has no $request/$request_uri/$args/$http_referer/$http_cookie; all 3 server blocks use it)
negative controls request-line-logged-again, stock-log-format-on-a-server
scripts/ui17-release-rehearsal.mjs phase access_log_credential_check
CI Docker step 'Security — the edge access log holds no credential (UI-17)'
defects.result: contract OK; controls fire; rehearsal: candidate edge log contains no synthetic token while the previous edge does
defects.remaining_risk: Logs written by any OTHER proxy/load balancer Phase 25 adds must use an equivalent format (runbook §2 P9).

defects.observed_problem: The context-handoff redirect sets `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, but the edge appended `strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, so a browser resolving the combined header applied the weaker policy (last valid token).
defects.evidence: Edge config: server-level `add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always;` with the FastCGI response already carrying the header; add_header appends rather than replaces.
defects.root_cause: nginx add_header semantics: upstream headers pass through and add_header adds another instance.
defects.why_root_cause: The application chooses the strict policy only on token-bearing responses; the duplicate is created solely by the edge directive.
defects.correct_fix: map $upstream_http_referrer_policy → the edge default only when the application set none (empty value suppresses the header).
tests: edge contract (no literal edge Referrer-Policy; map required)
negative control literal-referrer-policy-appended
scripts/ui17-edge-smoke.mjs: handoff response carries exactly ['no-referrer'] on all 8 hosts; shell carries exactly one policy

defects.observed_problem: Any website could read anonymous /api/v1 responses from a visitor's browser; every preflight was approved.
defects.evidence: N-1: OPTIONS /api/v1/me with Origin https://attacker.example → 204 Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; GET → 401 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
defects.root_cause: No config/cors.php, so Laravel's framework default (paths api/*, allowed_origins ['*']) applied.
defects.why_root_cause: HandleCors reads config('cors'); the vendor default is the wildcard.
defects.correct_fix: config/cors.php with an EMPTY approved origin set: every account host calls its own same-origin API, no host calls another host's API, partners are server-to-server.
tests: tests/Feature/Security/Ui17BrowserEdgeSecurityTest.php (4 foreign origins × preflight and response, csrf-cookie, config pin)
edge smoke CORS checks on 8 hosts
defects.command: docker exec servana-app-1 php artisan test tests/Feature/Security/Ui17BrowserEdgeSecurityTest.php
defects.remaining_risk: Adding a cross-origin consumer later needs its own authorization.

defects.observed_problem: With SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE unset, production session and XSRF cookies were not Secure.
defects.evidence: config/session.php `secure => env('SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE')` → null → Symfony falls back to Request::isSecure(); behind the edge that derives from nginx $scheme (http whenever TLS terminates upstream). N-1 rehearsal: Set-Cookie without `secure`.
defects.root_cause: A fail-open default that depended on topology.
defects.why_root_cause: No other code sets the Secure attribute.
defects.correct_fix: Default `secure` to true when APP_ENV=production; explicit env still wins; the prod image also pins SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true.
tests: Ui17BrowserEdgeSecurityTest (production default, explicit override both ways, local default)
candidate image probe: Set-Cookie … secure; httponly; samesite=lax
defects.result: both cookies `secure`; session `httponly`; `samesite=lax`; no Domain attribute
defects.remaining_risk: Local HTTP rehearsals now need SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=false explicitly to sign in over plain HTTP.

defects.observed_problem: A production image started without a mounted .env rendered full stack-trace error pages (SQLSTATE, framework paths).
defects.evidence: N-1 image, DB-less: GET /auth/switch?token=<synthetic> → 500, 953,111-byte debug page containing SQLSTATE/Illuminate; container .env = copied .env.example with APP_DEBUG=true.
defects.root_cause: The shared entrypoint copies .env.example when no .env exists; its development values (APP_DEBUG=true, SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=false) applied in the prod image because the prod stage pinned only APP_ENV.
defects.why_root_cause: Dotenv never overrides process env; APP_ENV stayed production, everything else came from .env.example.
defects.correct_fix: Pin APP_DEBUG=false and SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true as prod-stage ENV (fail closed; an orchestrator can still override). Replacing the .env.example fallback and per-container APP_KEY with a secrets store remains Phase 25.
tests: Ui17BrowserEdgeSecurityTest 'pins fail-closed debug and cookie defaults into the production image only'
candidate probe: same request → 500 generic 6,665-byte page, 0 stack-trace markers
defects.remaining_risk: Per-container APP_KEY generation (sessions not shared across replicas) — Phase 25 (UI17-OBS-ENTRYPOINT).

defects.observed_problem: No Content-Security-Policy, Permissions-Policy or HSTS was sent by any host (UI/UX plan §18.6 requires CSP and HSTS).
defects.evidence: N-1 shell response headers: only nosniff, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy.
defects.root_cause: The edge comment deferred 'a stricter CSP' to Phase 23, which never added one.
defects.why_root_cause: No other layer sets these headers.
defects.correct_fix: Strict CSP (self only; the single inline theme script by SHA-256; blob: images for the Merchant Profile logo preview; frame-ancestors/object-src/base-uri none), Permissions-Policy denying unused powerful features, HSTS emitted only over HTTPS and staged at max-age=0 until production TLS is validated.
tests: edge contract + 6 edge negative controls
Pest: rendered Blade script hash == CSP hash
origin browser gate: 0 securitypolicyviolation on /, /login, /faq, /legal/privacy-policy × 8 hosts, light and dark; explicit dark still applies before paint
defects.result: 40/40 passed on the candidate; the UI-17 spec fails 16/24 on N-1 (negative control)
defects.remaining_risk: Authenticated pages cannot be reached by the anonymous origin gate; a static sweep found only the blob: logo preview (allowed) — first authenticated production use should watch the browser console. HSTS stays staged until runbook §8.

defects.observed_problem: Found by UI-17's own browser gate: with the new CSP, four small font subsets were refused ('Loading the font data:font/woff2… violates font-src').
defects.evidence: First candidate (cand-a3c45d2fb773) console; built CSS contained 4 url(data:font/…) entries.
defects.root_cause: Vite inlines assets under 4 KiB as data: URIs; four @fontsource subset files fell under the limit.
defects.why_root_cause: No other data: usage exists in the CSS.
defects.correct_fix: build.assetsInlineLimit returns false for font files, so they are emitted as fingerprinted files; font-src stays 'self'.
tests: bundle gate fails on any data: font in emitted CSS (proven against the defective build)
edge contract pins font-src 'self'
negative controls font-inlined-as-data-uri, data-fonts-allowed
defects.result: fails on the old build (4 inlined fonts), passes after; initial CSS 22.4 → 14.7 KiB gzip

defects.observed_problem: Every fingerprinted chunk crossed the wire uncompressed.
defects.evidence: N-1: GET entry js with Accept-Encoding: gzip, br → 120,731 bytes, no Content-Encoding; nginx.conf `#gzip on;`.
defects.root_cause: The base image ships gzip commented out and the Servana config never enabled it.
defects.why_root_cause: No CDN or other layer exists in front of the edge.
defects.correct_fix: gzip (level 6, the budget method) for css/js/svg/webmanifest ≥1 KiB, enabled only inside the static-asset locations; HTML and API JSON left uncompressed (BREACH precondition).
tests: edge contract (gzip in exactly 3 asset locations, not http-level, no application/json)
negative control gzip-at-http-level
edge smoke: entry js/css gzip + Vary on 8 hosts
origin gate: every chunk ≥1 KiB gzip
defects.result: landing transfer 785 → 473 KiB (servana.ke, mobile, first sample)
defects.remaining_risk: Brotli would save a further ~12% but needs a module the stock image lacks; a CDN can add it (Phase 25).

defects.observed_problem: Landing CLS up to 0.174 (budget 0.1) on mobile and 0.121 on desktop; LCP re-painted ~5 s.
defects.evidence: layout-shift-attribution-before.json: one shift at ~5.0 s per host — footer links widened 4–10 px and wrapped, hero copy grew a line and moved the CTA 48 px; fonts loadingdone at ~5.7 s.
defects.root_cause: font-display: swap with an unadjusted system fallback, and fonts discovered only after the SPA rendered text.
defects.why_root_cause: Every shift source is a text box whose width/height changed at the swap; no image or async-content shift occurred.
defects.correct_fix: Metric-compatible 'Inter Fallback'/'Manrope Fallback' faces (overrides derived from the shipped WOFF metrics + measured widths) named in the font tokens; Tailwind font utilities read the tokens; the two hero faces preloaded on `/`.
tests: web vitals after (CLS max 0.0016 across 8 hosts × 2 profiles)
Ui17ShellCriticalPathTest font preload cases
origin gate font preload CORS + 200
DesignTokenSchemaTest (families still start with Inter/Manrope)
tokens:check
defects.remaining_risk: Android has none of the local faces listed; it falls back unadjusted (as before). tokens.generated.ts gets a new SHA-256 source digest that gitleaks flags as generic-api-key — Codex adds the per-commit fingerprint as in UI-04/UI-16.

defects.observed_problem: The entry chunk's static imports were requested only after the entry downloaded and parsed (+0.75 s on slow 4G); landing chunks one level later still.
defects.evidence: Before waterfall: index js 256→1474 ms, then apiClient/runtime-core 1487→2253 ms; landing copy/composition 3731→4046 ms.
defects.root_cause: The Laravel shell names only the entry script; Vite's own index.html would carry modulepreload for its imports.
defects.why_root_cause: After the fix every critical chunk starts at ~285 ms in parallel.
defects.correct_fix: modulepreload for the entry's static-import closure on every page, plus on `/` the landing page chunk and THIS account's composition + copy, all from the real manifest; unknown keys skipped, never guessed.
tests: Ui17ShellCriticalPathTest (closure on 8 hosts × 3 paths; landing hints for own account only; none on /login)
origin gate: hints resolve 200 in-page; exactly 2 landing hints
defects.command: docker exec servana-app-1 php artisan test tests/Feature/Hosts/Ui17ShellCriticalPathTest.php
defects.remaining_risk: Authenticated dashboards are not preloaded (§6.5 allows it); not measured on an authenticated origin in UI-17.

defects.observed_problem: GET /api/v1/me was sent twice on every cold load.
defects.root_cause: The router guard awaits bootstrap() while App.vue's mount fallback checks `bootstrapped`, which flips only when the request ends.
defects.why_root_cause: Only those two call sites run on a cold load.
defects.correct_fix: Concurrent bootstrap() callers share one in-flight request; a later call refetches (onboarding refresh).
tests: authStore.spec: concurrent callers → 1 GET; settled → refetch
origin gate: exactly one GET /api/v1/me per cold load on 8 hosts (fails on N-1)

defects.observed_problem: Found by the UI-17 release rehearsal: behind a front nginx load balancer every chunk was served uncompressed again, undoing UI17-PERF-001.
defects.evidence: staging-rehearsal (first run): edge smoke through the LB failed `entry js compressed (content-encoding none)` on all 8 hosts, while the same image served gzip to a direct HTTP/1.1 client.
defects.root_cause: nginx proxy_pass speaks HTTP/1.0 to its upstream by default and the edge kept the stock gzip_http_version 1.1, so it refused to compress for the proxied request.
defects.why_root_cause: Same image, same Accept-Encoding: direct HTTP/1.1 → gzip; via an HTTP/1.0 hop → none.
defects.correct_fix: gzip_http_version 1.0 at the edge, so compression does not depend on how the load balancer in front (Phase 25) is configured. The rehearsal LB is deliberately left at the HTTP/1.0 default to prove the worst case.
tests: edge contract requires gzip_http_version 1.0
negative control gzip-lost-behind-http10-proxy
rehearsal promote phase: full edge smoke through the HTTP/1.0 LB

defects.observed_problem: Landing LCP p75 (lab) misses 2.5 s on the strictest mobile profile even after the fixes.
defects.evidence: performance-baseline-and-budget.json: mobile-slow-4g (1.6 Mbit/s, 150 ms RTT, 4x CPU) p75 2,988–3,172 ms on 8/8 hosts after (4,696–5,144 before); mobile-fast-4g (9 Mbit/s, 60 ms, 4x CPU) p75 2,008–2,208 ms — 8/8 PASS after (1/8 before); desktop p75 976–1,240 ms. Logo A/B: no LCP effect (p75 3,108 vs 3,048 ms).
affected_files: (architecture) client-rendered SPA landing; global router guard awaits /me before any route renders
defects.root_cause: Remaining critical path is bandwidth for ~250 KB of first-render bytes plus JS execution at 4x CPU plus a blocking /me round trip before the public route renders — no single defect remains.
defects.why_root_cause: All critical chunks now start in parallel at ~285 ms; no long task after the first render; aborting the logo changes nothing.
defects.correct_fix: Not applied — product/architecture decisions: (a) agree the p75 profile (UI/UX plan §22.1 says "agreed"): on Fast 4G every host passes; (b) render public routes without awaiting /me (≈ −0.2–0.35 s on slow 4G; changes when the MFA redirect is evaluated on public pages); (c) prerender the public landing HTML server-side (architecture change).
tests: web vitals profiles recorded
defects.remaining_risk: Budget acceptance (UI/UX plan §28.9 'pass or approved evidence-based exception') needs the product owner's decision D8.

defects.observed_problem: None of the eight production hosts resolves.
defects.evidence: dns-tls-matrix.json: KeNIC delegates servana.ke to ns1–4.a2hosting.com; all four answer REFUSED, non-authoritative; 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 SERVFAIL for all 8 hosts.
defects.root_cause: Lame delegation — the zone is not served by the delegated nameservers.
defects.why_root_cause: Raw queries to each delegated server return REFUSED.
defects.correct_fix: DNS owner serves the zone at the delegated provider or changes the delegation; then certificates (runbook §2 P2–P3).
tests: scripts/ui17-dns-tls-probe.mjs
defects.remaining_risk: Blocks every live production acceptance item.
